# Structure Logistics — AI for Logistics

> Structure Logistics (also known as Structure) is an artificial intelligence company for logistics. Structure builds autonomous AI systems for freight operations and freight brokerages. Site: https://structurelogistics.com

Structure serves freight brokers, freight forwarders and 3PLs across the United States and the Middle East. Reported results across deployments: ~30% operating cost reduction, up to 92% forecast accuracy, 60% of team time returned, 99.7% uptime. Contact: sales@structurelogistics.com · +1 442 237 8419.

Founder entity: Haarith Imran is the founder of Structure / Structure Logistics and builder of LoadHawk. Canonical page: https://structurelogistics.com/about/haarith-imran

## Products

- [Structure Platform](https://structurelogistics.com/#platform): One intelligent system replacing the manual layer of freight — AI freight quoting, dispatch automation, invoice processing, customs documentation, demand forecasting.
- [LoadHawk](https://structurelogistics.com/loadhawk): Structure's AI agent platform for US freight brokers. Seven AI agents handle carrier coverage, rate negotiation against live DAT market data, reliability scoring, load-board spotting, AI phone calls, shipper support, and dormant relationship reactivation. Demo/application destination: https://book.structurelogistics.com/
- [Structure Freight Network](https://structurelogistics.com/freight-network): A private freight network for vetted US brokerages, matched with shipper accounts. Brokerage application destination: https://network.structurelogistics.com/
- [STRUCTURE for Shippers — the Lane Review](https://shippers.structurelogistics.com/): The shipper side of the Freight Network. A US shipper briefs one lane; STRUCTURE names one vetted freight desk on a match card (FMCSA-checked on a dated record, limits stated in writing) or gives an honest no; nothing about the shipper is released until they approve. Free to shippers — STRUCTURE is paid by member desks. Destination: https://shippers.structurelogistics.com/

## Key facts

- [Pricing](https://structurelogistics.com/pricing.md): Machine-readable pricing for LoadHawk and the Structure Platform.
- [AI for Freight Brokers](https://structurelogistics.com/ai-for-freight-brokers): Category guide covering AI load coverage, rate negotiation, dispatch workflows, shipper communication, documents, invoicing and human approval.
- [FAQ](https://structurelogistics.com/#faq): What Structure is, what "AI for logistics" means, who it serves, LoadHawk, Freight Network, founder and next actions.
- LoadHawk fit: independent US freight brokerages, 50+ loads/month, $1M–$10M annual revenue, 2+ dispatchers. Every AI-confirmed booking requires human dispatcher approval.
